entities.name: Association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and UE Tx TEG ID procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to provide association information between UL SRS Resource for positioning and UE Tx TEG ID.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: UE state where the procedure for providing association information can be initiated.

entities.name: Configured to provide association information
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured to provide association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and UE Tx TEG ID.

entities.name: SRS-Config IE
entities.description: Information Element containing configuration for SRS resources.

entities.name: ue-TxTEG-RequestUL-TDOA-Config
entities.description: Field in SRS-Config IE configured to request association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG.

entities.name: UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to provide positioning assistance information including association data.

relations.description: Procedure initiation requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure initiation is guarded by UE being configured to provide association information.
SRS-Config IE contains the ue-TxTEG-RequestUL-TDOA-Config field.
When ue-TxTEG-RequestUL-TDOA-Config is configured, UE initiates transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message.
Procedure includes transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message as a step.
